entries.alt: Four fictional adult women in short bronze, amber-blue, magenta-silver, and teal-gold RAZE looks wear sculptural knee-high boots on Tartu's Emajõgi promenade while the woman at right kisses her neighbor's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in short copper, silver, plum-blue, and teal RAZE looks stand in heels beside Copenhagen's Nyhavn canal as the woman at left kisses the blonde woman's cheek, with colorful historic facades behind them.

Four fictional adult women in short opaque copper, red, silver, and emerald RAZE fashion stand close on Sarajevo's Miljacka promenade, linking hands while one gives another a cheek kiss, with an arched bridge and the colorful Vijećnica skyline behind them.

Extreme-close portrait of four fictional adult women in green-gold, copper, cobalt and silver-plum couture linking hands as the far-right woman kisses the third woman's cheek, with Melnik's golden sandstone pyramids and vineyard rows behind them.
Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and blue-green RAZE outfits wear pumps and bright rainbow knee-highs on Galway's Long Walk as the two women at right share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-blue, pearl-lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear gradient rainbow thigh-high stockings and heels beside the Neris in Vilnius, with Gediminas Tower rising above the riverfront.

Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE outfits wear rainbow knee-high socks and pumps on Jurmala's Dzintari boardwalk as the two women at right share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-blue, pearl-lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear black thigh-high hosiery and pumps above Luxembourg City's Alzette valley and stone viaducts.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze-teal, pearl-blue and copper, ruby-black, and emerald-silver and cobalt looks wear opaque stockings and pumps above Larvotto's pristine bay in Monaco.

Four fictional adult women stand arm in arm beside Oslo Opera House and the harbor, wearing sharply shortened red, pearl, blue and emerald RAZE fashion looks with star panels, pumps and one navy branded stocking.
Four fictional adult women share a warm full-body pose before intact Spis Castle, wearing short blue, white, silver and green RAZE looks, rainbow over-the-knee stockings and complete classic pumps.

Four fictional adult women gather in a close side-hug and supported seated pose beneath the Momo double-helix staircase, wearing short yellow, white and bronze looks with Vatican key-and-tiara motifs, rainbow knee-highs and gold, ivory, blue RAZE and bronze heels.

Four fictional adult women share a close back-hug on a bright terrace above Lake Suchitlan near Suchitoto. They wear secure short blue-and-white editorial looks with visible IA and scorpion tattoos; distant fictional smoke and fire appear across the water.

Four fictional adult women share a seated handclasp and side hug at Gardens by the Bay's Supertree Grove. They wear short red, white and metallic Singapore-inspired outfits with red stilettos, white boots, silver knee-high boots and rainbow knee-high hosiery.

Four fictional adult women sit close together beneath Jeita Grotto's dramatic limestone formations. They link hands and rest shoulders together in short Lebanon flag, white, bronze and ivory outfits with rainbow pumps, white boots, rainbow sandals and green knee-high boots.

Four fictional adult women overlap in a close side hug beside the archaeological terraces of Tell es-Sultan, Jericho. Palestinian flag looks, a green top and black RAZE shorts frame an IA tattoo. A distant smoke cloud is part of this fictional AI scene, not a report of a real event.

Four fictional adult women share close side hugs and linked hands on a stone terrace above Queenstown, Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables. Short New Zealand flag looks pair with blue platforms, silver ankle boots, green stilettos and crimson rainbow knee-high boots.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale rose, teal-black, and plum RAZE looks wear rainbow bands and tall branded statement boots with split-star heels at Esch-Belval, with stylized smoke far behind the blast furnaces.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze, pearl, turquoise-ivory, and plum RAZE looks wear metallic knee-high statement boots with split-star heels below Gutenberg Castle and the Alpine ridges at Balzers.

Four fictional adult women in short copper-blue, lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks stand linked at Dublin's Grand Canal Dock while the woman at left kisses the blonde woman and a stylized smoke cloud rises far behind the glass skyline.
Four fictional adult women in short copper-black, lilac, red-blue-white, and emerald RAZE looks stand in heels in Tallinn's Rotermann Quarter as the woman at left kisses the blonde woman's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in short turquoise, gold-white, copper-blue, and green RAZE looks stand closely linked in colorful architectural heels on Limassol's Molos promenade beside a modern sculpture and Mediterranean waterfront.

Four fictional adult women in short opaque turquoise-gold, pearl-rose, cobalt-magenta, and emerald-plum RAZE looks stand closely linked on Rovinj's harbor promenade with knee-high hosiery, sculptural footwear, and geometric star hardware.

Four fictional adult women in bright short opaque RAZE couture and sculptural gold, copper, teal, and purple knee-high boots stand together at Kravica Waterfalls, sharing a cheek kiss and linked-hands reunion.

Four fictional adult women in turquoise, blush, navy, and plum cropped RAZE jackets with short opaque skirts stand close at a golden Andorran mountain overlook, holding hands in knee-high hosiery and minimalist heels.
Four fictional adult women in short opaque turquoise, rose, cobalt and emerald couture link hands on Varna's Sea Garden promenade as the far-right woman kisses the third woman's cheek.
Four fictional women in pomegranate, cobalt, turquoise and copper couture link hands on Baku's rain-polished Caspian waterfront, with the Flame Towers and marina behind them.
Four fictional women in coral, black, cobalt-white and silver couture laugh through a safe splash on Thessaloniki's rain-polished waterfront, with the White Tower and Thermaic Gulf behind them.
Four fictional women in navy, white-gold, berry-red and silver couture join hands during a cheek kiss on Stockholm's Riddarfjarden waterfront, with City Hall, bridges and ferries behind them.

Four fictional women in white-gold, teal, magenta and coral couture share a playful cheek kiss and linked-hands reconciliation on Bangkok's Chao Phraya waterfront, with Rama VIII Bridge and ferries behind them.
Four fictional women in teal, white-gold, black-magenta and coral couture share a playful romantic reconciliation above Phang Nga Bay's limestone karsts and emerald water.
Four fictional women in Tanzania-inspired couture embrace on Dar es Salaam's Kivukoni waterfront at sunset, with a harbor ferry and glass skyline behind them.
